absentByDesign: an EOS field (CTC has no EOS token)
keptNative: nativeCtcSequenceScore is in [0, 1] and is never rescaled
rawTimestepProbabilities are in [0, 1] and are never rescaled

fields.opaqueItemId: string — opaque identifier; never a brand name, filename or producer name

engine.runtimeId: string — Docker image id of the container that ran inference
engine.runtimePackagesHash: string — SHA-256 of pip freeze inside the container

model.modelCommit: string — immutable HF revision, expected b8f84f0b80c529de40b4fbb3544b84fa7233a513
model.vocabSize: number — total output width including the CTC blank
model.ctcBlankTokenId: number — determined empirically from the postprocessor, not assumed
model.dictSha256: string — SHA-256 of the concatenated PostProcess.character_dict

input.modelInputWidth: number — the padded tensor width; 320 under upstream padding=True
input.paddingColumnsAdded: number — zero-padding columns on the right
input.validRatio: number — min(1, resizedWidth / 320), as upstream computes it
input.transformDescription: string — must document BGR and the resize
input.transformedTensorSha256: string — over the contiguous float32 buffer

output.rawLogitsArtifact: string — path to the frozen .npy, written before any comparison
output.modelOutputAlreadyNormalized: boolean — measured, because the exported graph may already emit probabilities
output.probabilitySource: 'model output as emitted' | 'softmax over model output'
output.rawTimestepTokenIds: number[] — argmax per time step, before collapsing
output.rawTimestepProbabilities: number[] — argmax probability per time step, in [0, 1]
output.collapsedTokenIds: number[] — after consecutive-duplicate removal, blanks retained
output.decodedCharacterIds: number[] — non-blank collapsed tokens in output order
output.rawTranscript: string — after duplicate removal and blank removal
output.normalizedTranscript: string — NFKD, strip combining marks, lowercase, non [a-z0-9 ] to space, collapse whitespace, trim
output.normalizedTranscriptWhitespaceFree: string — normalizedTranscript with all spaces stripped
output.emptyTranscript: boolean — structural CTC outcome, NOT governed abstention
output.nativeCtcSequenceScore: number — mean over non-blank time steps of the argmax probability (§6.1 as frozen); 0.0 when emptyTranscript
output.upstreamCollapsedMeanScore: number — mean over duplicate-collapsed non-blank positions, as the pinned upstream decode implements it

execution.outputFingerprint: string — SHA-256 of canonical JSON of rawTimestepTokenIds and rawTranscript

dictionaryAudit.asciiSpacePresent: boolean — whether ASCII space is a decodable token
dictionaryAudit.asciiSpaceInInferenceYmlDict: boolean — whether it appears in PostProcess.character_dict

evaluation.applicability: NOT APPLICABLE to this compatibility probe. There is no governed truth in scope: the inputs are two synthetic images, and the probe does not test Brand recognition capability. The corpus-oriented fields below are defined for the later frozen-crop benchmark and are emitted as null here rather than populated against a sentinel string.
evaluation.falseCertainty: boolean — nativeCtcSequenceScore >= 0.8 AND failureClass is wrong

sentinelComparison.note: Used in place of `evaluation` for this probe. Compares against the sentinel text fixed by the plan, which is an input specification rather than corpus truth.
